_doc: Live view settings for this app (sensor-debug: sensor_dash.py --app <app>). Keys: see .claude/skills/sensor-debug/web/config.json. Knobs: POTS vr1..vr4 (raw 0..4095). CapSense: frame3 firmware -> CAPS btn0/btn1/slider; raw5 firmware (5-segment slider) -> CAPS touch/slider 0..100 + d0..d4 (drop per segment, counts). EVT lines (every change, 50 ms poll) go to the log. The bridge keeps the raw log (<app>/logs/liveview-*.log). Raw 4000T view: 'ezreport 200' -> FRAME (SDK 3-byte frame b0..b2 + SDK button decode sdk_btn0/1) and EZW w0..w22 (buffer words, unsigned).
title: QWA309 inputs - knobs + CapSense
